content:
incident-bot: ALERT: sustained errors and queue growth on /v1/embeddings and increased CPU on embedder-pool us-west-2. Starts 2026-11-21T02:14:07Z. Paging embed-oncall @claire :rotating_light:
claire: ACK. pulling dashboards (qps, tokens/sec, kv-evictions). can someone grab top 5 api_keys by tokens?
izzy: on it. query shows key-A (batch job from partner X) and key-C (incremental background) are spiking. key-A is sending 10k requests of ~2k tokens each, concurrency ~40.
raj: chat routes remain nominal. rerank calls remain doing prefilter embeddings and effectively doubling embedding traffic for some customers.
claire: ok immediate mitigations: per-endpoint quotas. want to limit embeddings by tokens/sec per-key and set a soft limit on rerank calls per-minute. also enable route-level traffic shaping (queue vs drop) for embeddings.
ops: risk note: rerank toggle will affect search quality for some customers; have support ready to notify. autoscaler nodes are cold-starting slowly; recommend quick +1 embed node.
claire: mitigation steps I'll apply now:
1) per-api-key embeddings tokens/sec cap (token-aware throttling)
2) route-level embed queue cap (max-inflight 200) with drop-oldest strategy
3) rerank per-tenant call cap (50 rpm) for non-enterprise
4) lower chat low-priority concurrency (background tenants) to protect latency
5) enable quota headers so clients get 429+X-Quota-Remaining info

claire: running admin commands:
```bash
# token-aware cap per key (example for key-A)
curl -sS -X POST https://admin.internal/limits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","scope":"per_api_key","api_key":"key-A","tokens_per_sec":1500,"burst_tokens":3000}'

# enable route queueing with drop-oldest
curl -sS -X POST https://admin.internal/route-config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","queue_max_inflight":200,"drop_strategy":"drop_oldest"}'

# cap rerank calls for non-enterprise
curl -sS -X POST https://admin.internal/limits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/rerank","scope":"non_enterprise","calls_per_minute":50}'
```

claire: admin returned 202s for each change. enabling quota headers and enabling soft-queue now.
incident-bot: ACTIONS: per-key token cap, route queueing, rerank cap applied by claire at 2026-11-21T02:23:45Z.
izzy: seeing immediate effect: tokens/sec for key-A dropped; embed p95 latency fell ~45% in 90s. 5xxs dropping from 2.6% -> 0.3% in 4m.
raj: rerank call rate limited; search prefilter retries hit 429s but with quota headers. should inform support to expect customer contacts.
support-bot: Draft message queued to affected API keys: "We've applied temporary rate controls on embeddings to protect platform stability. If this blocks your workflows, please contact success@redwood.ai or request a Dedicated quota increase." :email:
pm-zoe: tagging product: need permanent per-endpoint knobs in console (tokens/sec, calls/min, queueing policy). also propose default rerank soft-limit for non-enterprise.
ops: bumped embed pool +1 node to reduce cold-start latency. recorded change in infra log.
claire: handoff to raj for monitoring for next 60m. notes: root cause likely a misconfigured partner job submitting giant batches without chunking + rerank prefilters multiplying load. temporary measures: token caps per offending keys, region route queueing, rerank cap on non-enterprise, chat concurrency lowered for background tenants. kept quota headers so clients get deterministic 429s instead of timeouts.
raj: taking over. will watch for further offenders and coordinate with support for any urgent customer escalations.
support-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATED -> "Embeddings degraded; mitigations in place. Some tenants may see rate-limited responses. We're monitoring."
izzy: saved query for post-incident RCA to identify contributing patterns:
```
select api_key, count(*) as reqs, sum(tokens) as tokens, max(concurrency) as max_conc
 from request_logs
 where route='/v1/embeddings' and time > now() - interval '2 hours'
 group by api_key order by tokens desc limit 20;
```
pm-zoe: requested follow-ups: 1) console UI for per-route quota knobs + tokens/sec display 2) autopilot rule: detect rerank->embed amplification and auto-apply rerank soft-cap 3) KB for customers on chunking + token-aware backoff 4) consider default X-Quota headers on all routes.
ops: filing ticket INC-2026-413, tags: live-mitigation:route-quota, impact:embeddings, owner=raj. linking runbook entry: https://internal/runbooks/embeddings-bulk.
claire: additional note: prefer token-aware limits over requests/sec for embeddings since payloads vary widely. also recommend a circuit-breaker metric on kv-evictions to trigger autoscale earlier.
raj: I'll coordinate postmortem and reach out to partner X to request changes. handing off to oncall rotation. closing thread unless we see a rollback spike. :white_check_mark:
